notes.title: Arcade/Story Demo Still In Development
notes.content:
Hello, Club Members! 🥊

We’re excited to share what we’ve been working on behind the scenes for Punch Kick Club!

Arcade Demo in the Works
We know many of you have been eagerly awaiting new content, and we’re thrilled to announce that a new Arcade Demo is on the way! 🎮 This demo is more than just battling the CPU—think of it as a small slice of a full arcade experience.

It will feature:

Challenges: Put your skills to the test with unique objectives with enemies.
CPU Battle: Sharpen your techniques against stronger AI opponent.
Boss Encounter: A thrilling finale to cap off your arcade run.
We’re aiming to release the demo at the start of the new year, before March. Thank you for your patience as we fine-tune the experience to make it truly special!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101348/e4d9a7f32caeabb78071d6b61fd08ee31f2497cf.png[/img]

Meet Fiona: The Potion-Crafting Zoner
We’re also introducing Fiona, a crafty new fighter who’s joining the club! 🧪 Fiona is a zoner with a dynamic playstyle centered around the random potions she creates mid-battle. These potions can tip the scales in unexpected ways—whether you’re fighting up close or keeping your opponent at bay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101348/e44f976e7f17c69178e693786f45d424fb60510a.png[/img]

We hope you’re as excited to meet Fiona as we are to finish bringing her to life.

Thank You for Waiting
We can’t thank you enough for your continued support and patience. Your enthusiasm inspires us to keep pushing Punch Kick Club to new heights. Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t hesitate to share your thoughts with us in the community discussions.

Let’s make this club the best it can be—together! 💪

- The Punch Kick Club Team
